title: Are They the Same?
statement: It asks whether array a (n up to 100) can become a permutation of b using a_i := 2a_i + k and a_i +-2 (values unrestricted). Since +-2 reaches every value of the same parity and 2a_i + k always has k's parity, only parities matter: elements of k's parity are locked, the rest can switch, so the answer is YES iff a has no more k-parity elements than b.
